title: SAFE-X: code, pre-registered study plans and results for calibrated expert sharing in federated intrusion detection
description: Code, sealed pre-registration plans and per-run results for the paper "SAFE-X: Calibrated expert sharing for detecting client-exclusive rare attacks in federated intrusion detection". The repository contains the federated training and baseline code, the SAFE-X method (shared owner experts, federated calibration and fusion), the analysis scripts for Studies 1 to 4 on NF-UNSW-NB15-v3, NF-ToN-IoT-v3 and NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018-v3, and the scripts that draw the paper's figures.
